card.name: Linking words before AUC / area under curve
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, by, as, and, higher) in drug interaction text, right before 'area under the curve' or 'AUC' is expected. Also fires at the end of a drug name just before AUC.

modes.label: Before 'area under the curve'
modes.description: A linking word after 'increase in' or 'measured as' that is followed by 'area under the ... curve'.
modes.example: a 20% increase in<< the>> area under the plasma concentration-time curve.

modes.label: Before the abbreviation AUC
modes.description: A word after a fold-change or Cmax mention that is followed by AUC.
modes.example: a 2.4-fold higher C max and a 4.5-fold<< higher>> AUC for thioridazine in

card.writes: It boosts 'area' and 'areas', pushing the next word to be 'area' as in area under the curve.
card.plain: It fires when a drug-interaction sentence is about to say 'area under the curve' (AUC) as a measure of drug exposure.
